evals.title: Audit is read-only and returns a digest
evals.prompt:
[Workspace state — read but do not narrate back:
- The design is approved, smoke is green, and the persisted report exists.
- `evaluate-ml-pipeline` dispatched this audit.]

Audit experiment 02 after evaluation.
evals.expected_output: Behavioural response satisfying: - Confirm the report with `project.summarize()` and load it with `project.get(id)`. - Render checks and metrics into the audit digest. - Return the digest and normalized report locator to the caller. It must NOT: - Call `skore.evaluate` or `project.put`. - Require the experiment to be `done` before audit. - Dispatch record-outcome before producing the digest.
expectations: Confirm the report with `project.summarize()` and load it with `project.get(id)`.
Render checks and metrics into the audit digest.
Return the digest and normalized report locator to the caller.
The response does NOT: Call `skore.evaluate` or `project.put`.
The response does NOT: Require the experiment to be `done` before audit.
The response does NOT: Dispatch record-outcome before producing the digest.
The response does NOT: Write the journal directly.

evals.title: Direct audit owns the close
evals.prompt:
[Workspace state — read but do not narrate back:
- This is a direct free-text invocation.
- The report exists and smoke is green.]

Re-audit experiment 03.
evals.expected_output: Behavioural response satisfying: - Surface the normalized persisted-report locator. - Run audit, then call `manage-ml-backlog` record-outcome with the digest and locator. - Build the site only after record-outcome when enabled. It must NOT: - Open the next-lever menu from record-outcome mode. - Call record-outcome before audit. - Run `git commit`.
expectations: Surface the normalized persisted-report locator.
Run audit, then call `manage-ml-backlog` record-outcome with the digest and locator.
Build the site only after record-outcome when enabled.
Close with `git end-turn --stage evaluate`.
The response does NOT: Open the next-lever menu from record-outcome mode.
The response does NOT: Call record-outcome before audit.
The response does NOT: Run `git commit`.

evals.title: Dispatched audit returns without a second close
evals.prompt:
[Workspace state — read but do not narrate back:
- `model-ml-pipeline` dispatched the audit.
- `cells run` already produced the digest.
- Normalized locator is
  `local workspace: [reports/](../reports/) · id: local-report-id`.]

Continue the model loop and audit the evaluated baseline.

It must NOT: - Run `git end-turn` or `persist-ml-git` from this skill (naming them as the **dispatcher's** close is allowed). - Load `triage-ml-task` from this skill. - Dispatch `manage-ml-backlog` from this skill.
expectations: Return the digest, locator, and optional headline to `model-ml-pipeline`.
State that the dispatcher owns record-outcome, site, and git close.
The response does NOT: Run `git end-turn` or `persist-ml-git` from this skill (naming them as the **dispatcher's** close is allowed).
The response does NOT: Load `triage-ml-task` from this skill.
The response does NOT: Dispatch `manage-ml-backlog` from this skill.

evals.title: Missing report stops without fabrication
evals.prompt:
[Workspace state — read but do not narrate back:
- The design is approved and smoke is green.
- `project.summarize()` has no row for experiment 04.]

Audit experiment 04.
evals.expected_output: Behavioural response satisfying: - Stop and report that the persisted report is missing. - Route recovery to evaluation. It must NOT: - Re-run `skore.evaluate` from audit. - Invent a report id, URL, metrics, or digest. - Mark the experiment done.
expectations: Stop and report that the persisted report is missing.
Route recovery to evaluation.
The response does NOT: Re-run `skore.evaluate` from audit.
The response does NOT: Invent a report id, URL, metrics, or digest.
The response does NOT: Mark the experiment done.
